title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
statement: Return the level-order traversal as a list of levels, from left to right, top to bottom.
hints: BFS with a queue is the definition of level order.
Snapshot the queue length at the start of each layer so you know when the layer ends.
Append node values for that many pops, and push the children.

approaches.name: BFS by layer
approaches.explanation: The queue holds one layer plus the next.

editorial: The queue invariant is that it contains exactly the next layer, left to right. Record its length, drain that many nodes, and enqueue their children. Each iteration of the outer loop is one level of the answer.
reference_solution:
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict, deque
import heapq

def level_order(root: list) -> list[list[int]]:
    node = _build(root)
    if node is None:
        return []
    out: list[list[int]] = []
    queue = [node]
    while queue:
        layer: list[int] = []
        nxt = []
        for current in queue:
            layer.append(current.value)
            if current.left:
                nxt.append(current.left)
            if current.right:
                nxt.append(current.right)
        out.append(layer)
        queue = nxt
    return out
